From 8141a2dc70080eda1aedc0389ed2db2b292af5bd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Ao Zhou <draw51280@163.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 22:52:07 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: rds: fix MR cleanup on copy error

__rds_rdma_map() hands sg/pages ownership to the transport after
get_mr() succeeds. If copying the generated cookie back to user space
fails after that point, the error path must not free those resources
again before dropping the MR reference.

Remove the duplicate unpin/free from the put_user() failure branch so
that MR teardown is handled only through the existing final cleanup
path.

Fixes: 0d4597c8c5ab ("net/rds: Track user mapped pages through special API")
Cc: stable@kernel.org
Reported-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Ao Zhou <draw51280@163.com>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Reviewed-by: Allison Henderson <achender@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/79c8ef73ec8e5844d71038983940cc2943099baf.1776764247.git.draw51280@163.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/rds/rdma.c b/net/rds/rdma.c
index aa6465dc742c..61fb6e45281b 100644
--- a/net/rds/rdma.c
+++ b/net/rds/rdma.c
@@ -326,10 +326,6 @@ static int __rds_rdma_map(struct rds_sock *rs, struct rds_get_mr_args *args,
 
 	if (args->cookie_addr &&
 	    put_user(cookie, (u64 __user *)(unsigned long)args->cookie_addr)) {
-		if (!need_odp) {
-			unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages);
-			kfree(sg);
-		}
 		ret = -EFAULT;
 		goto out;
 	}
-- 
2.34.1

### Modifications in Each File

**net/rds/rdma.c**  
- Removed the `unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages)` and `kfree(sg)` calls from the error branch when `put_user()` fails after a successful `get_mr()` call. Previously, this code would attempt to free the pages and scatterlist when copying the cookie back to user space failed, which is incorrect because ownership has already been transferred to the transport.

### Relationships Between Changes

The sole change directly addresses a resource management bug: after `__rds_rdma_map()` passes MR ownership to the transport via a successful `get_mr()`, any subsequent failure (here, a `put_user()` error) must not free the underlying pages or scatterlist—those resources are now managed by the transport. The removed code would cause a double‑unpin/double‑free or a leak, as the transport’s own cleanup path would attempt to free them again. By deleting those lines, the error path now correctly falls through to the existing final cleanup (`out`) which only releases the MR reference, leaving teardown to the transport. This ensures consistent cleanup and fixes the reported bug.
